nkf-utf8/nkf.c.reason: ASan/UBSan reproduce negative JIS X0201 kana table indexing on the original full-byte input. Invalid table indices are now ignored after flushing a preceding valid kana; defined table entries and all other conversion paths remain unchanged.
nkf-utf8/nkf.c.mime_eof_fix: Avoid buf[-1] when an open MIME output word ends with an empty pending buffer; retain normal eof_mime flushing.
nkf-utf8/nkf.c.iso2022jp_eof_fix: Forward EOF before constructing a two-byte range-check value; eliminates left shift of negative EOF without changing its output.
nkf-utf8/nkf.c.shiftjis_trail_fix: Reject trail bytes below 0x40 before c1-0x40 extension table lookup. Deterministic malformed-byte sanitizer corpus reproduced negative indexing.
nkf-utf8/nkf.c.x0212_x0213_bounds_fix: Reject non-graphic low-seven-bit trail before a 94-entry JIS X0212 table lookup; bound the JIS X0213 plane selector below as well as above.
